verification: CP40 adds three smarter-companion upgrades behind feature flags that all ship OFF (assistant-context, assistant-quick-ask, assistant-nudges): next-step cards from real progress, an offline quick-ask router to the right app, and calm once-a-day reminders. No server, no AI credits, no visible change until a flag is raised. MemberAuthBridge also exposes the access token in context for flag rollouts. Homepage structure is unchanged. CI, Cloudflare deployment and production smoke remain mandatory.
